# Tony Hoang - AI Educator

> Vietnamese AI educator helping beginners learn artificial intelligence through practical courses and content.

## About

Tony Hoang (Trần Văn Hoàng) is an AI educator based in Vietnam. He teaches AI fundamentals, AI for marketing, prompt engineering, and AI automation to Vietnamese-speaking audiences.

- Website: https://tranvanhoang.com
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@tony-hoang-ai-automation
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/hoanghd218/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/hoanghd218/
